reviews.x: These lashes are a great value!  I haven't worn false eyelashes in forever and forgot how it can totally transform your face.  In the first picture, I'm only wearing one eyelash to show the difference.  You'll have to excuse the fact that I'm not wearing any makeup but you can see the dramatic difference in the 2nd picture.

reviews.t: The best lashes in the market
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:98357f278d38319ec85d62bbdb60de94]] This is the best product ever; I don’t have to soil my hands with glue while trying to wear eyelashes. I wish I discovered this earlier. Thanks so much for making this product available and affordable. It’s easy to wear and it came pretty fast. Order yours today and you will be happy you did.

At first, I wanted to give this a 4 star review. Initially, my biggest issue was the eyeliner applicator isn't the best. The brush itself is too long so it's hard to be precise and it got product all over my eyelashes. Personally, I would probably rarely if every use these as I don't wear eyeliner very often and never as thick as you have to apply it for these. Even if it would stick with a thinner line, the magnetic base of the eyelashes is pretty thick so it gives the impression of a thick eye

I haven't had eyelashes since I was 4yrs old. When I lost all my hair. My sister told me about these magnetic eyelashes and I was skeptical since I thought they needed eyelashes to hold onto for a fuller look. I was wrong the magnetic holds them well without eyelashes!! I know you can't see well in photos but I wanted to start with the less hair on lashes since it was my first time. The suddle lashes are what I needed. I'm crying!! Thank you!!

I've always struggled with fake eyelashes because they're so difficult to glue on correctly the first time. These magnetic eyelashes allow you to line up your lashes and move them around without ruining your eye look underneath. You just put the magnetic liner on like regular eyeliner and the lashes attach easily to that. The wide range of lengths allows for a customizable eye look depending on your mood. Great product for a great price!

These are good quality lashes they have mini magnets applied to the backs. They can be cut to lash size.  This product gives multiple options in length and style  to choose from. Pros: These eye lashes are easy to apply the liner and wear. The liner last through the day They wear with  no issues they last under water  Cons: The liner can be difficult to get off With mini magnets to trim down  to a perfect fit  makes it difficult.

Prior to this purchase, I tried Eyelure Promagnetic Lash eyeliner w/ lashes.  It was horrible.  Had to apply 3 coats of eyeliner and then the lashes didn't even stick.  With this Amazon purchase, I was amazed at the strong hold.  One coat of eyeliner and the lashes held beautifully... even the ends!!  The only downfall is that you really need to be an expert using liquid eyeliner.  I am not.  So practice makes perfect.  Every time gets better.  When applying, a magnetic 'chunk' will sometimes ap

Works great! Lashes look real, and the magnets really stay in place. Takes some time to learn how to set them so it doesn't feel like there's something on your lashes. Also, I recommend using a non-magnetic eye liner to line your eyes first, and then put just small dashes of the magnetic lash along your lid after. The magnetic liner is pretty hard to remove, even with oil-based remover or soap - the first time I used this product I used the magnetic liner only and it took forever to come off. No

I have tried for years to use the glue on false eyelashes but was never able to master the skill necessary to get them to stay on.  These went on in seconds and stayed on all day.  Literally in the time I used to use lining my eyes and applying 2 coats of mascara  I can  put these on and have lashes I can finally see.  My bio lashes are short, light brown, and fairly sparse so it was taking a lot of mascara just to barely see them.  With these babies I can look in the mirror and there they are!

reviews.t: Stop! These are the Eyelashes YOU need!
reviews.x: I bought these as I recently stopped wearing salon eyelash extensions. I needed a quick fix, to give my eyes a nice pop. I was so use to having lashes, my original lashes were damaged.  I was not happy with my salon eyelash extensions. I love the magnetic eyelashes, they are easy to apply and last all day.  I hope this review helps you in your purchase. The selection in this kit is perfect. You can go full glamour or subtle glam.  Plus, the little travel kit is a cute touch.

reviews.t: Awesome and EASY for virtual meetings!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:5f99fa2a451e7e5b98a094d80e894109]] Got these to enhance my eyes on my many Zoom meetings because mascara alone wasn’t cutting it. I can even use these without mascara!  Super easy-just shake the liner, apply and place lashes. Easy peasy! Made a silly video for my friend (complete with the duck lip pout) and decided to share so you can see the lashes in full effect! No judging!

These are great amongst other eyelashes ive used. They latch great and stay all day used the same pair for an entire week and honestly still have plenty of use. The eyeliner im not particularly a fan of. It doesnt seem to latch as well if you have glitter eyeshadow opposed to just a light color, and it will get clumpy if going over the same spot too many times trying to perfect it. Also if any of the liner gets on the natural lash (i have naturally long lashes just like the pop) it can be a hass

I’ve done lash extensions for a while now but ultimately end up regretting it because of how badly they break off your real lashes. These are such a great alternative solution to enhance your lashes on a tight schedule or budget! Quick and easy! A little bit of a learning curve at first because the liner is very sticky when wet! So I’d recommend doing your best not to get it on your actual lashes or on the fake lashes because it’ll clump them together. But then again I was able to just brush the

Great packaging Easy to apply and remove - I’ve never used false lashes before and these were super simple to apply and remove - Definitely are a great value for the price. You get 2 tubes of the magnetic liner and so many different lashes to choose from!! - This also comes with a travel compact with a mirror and a special place to store one set of lashes!!! Definitely would recommend this product!!

I saw these on a You Tube channel and was surprised at how easily they appeared to go on.  I took a chance and was not disappointed.  I never wear top eye liner because I'm horrible at it, but for some reason I have no problem using the magnetic liner in this kit.  Once it drys the lashes literally pop right on with zero effort.  First time trying false lashes and this kit is definitely a winner.

Love these lashes! My first magnetic lashes n so happy i tried so much easier than the strip. Had 3 friends purchase these after trying mine. Only downsides are the eyeliner is really hard to remove, and that I was only able to use half the provided lashes. I prefer full looking lashes The others are way to short/thin. But for the price its still not bad.

I absolutely LOVE these lashes! I have extremely sensitive eyes and I was afraid the eyeliner would irritate my eyes....but it does not! I have had other brands of magnetic lashes in the past and the eyeliner burned my eyes. The variety that you get and hands down the best I have seen.  I will probably never wear the thickest/longest ones, but that's ok.

I was skeptic about trying these magnetic lashes because I have never been able to put on lashes with glue but I knew I could so much own eyeliner. These stick great I still need a little more practice with the liner but they look amazing on! I was worried about them looking super fake and they don’t at all they still look natural but are very full!

reviews.t: Good value for the price and easy for beginners
reviews.x: Easy to use. Lots of variety of lash sizes. Love that they come with two eyeliners. They don't last ad long as other magnetic lashes as far as wear but definitely worth it for the price.
The liner is horrible and sticky. This is the 3rd type of magnetic lashes I've used and this is the worst.
I really love everything about it!! I played with different looks which is fun!!

For a whole year now during COVID I haven't worn mascara, I have always hated putting it on! I still wear shadow, eyeliner and a little blush and of course I take care of my eyebrows! But I decided I wanted to complete my look without mascara and the messy glue on lashes! I decided I wanted to try the magnetic lashes, so I read a lot of reviews and I chose these and I am glad I did! So easy to put on and take off and they stay on! Just be sure to read all of the instructions first, for example:

reviews.t: Best magnetic ones I have used so far
reviews.x: I used a couple different brands of magnetic eyeliner and lashes but these are by far my favorite. I'm not sure what it is but these stayed a lot better than other ones. I do have to put on a thicker layer to make sure they stay I actually like it better than what I used to do. I have tried glue lashes before and they are a hard no for me. I just can't do them. These are so easy for me and I love them. My only complaint is that the eyeliner does irritate my eyelid a little but I also have very s

I am very happy with these lashes.  I am a cancer patient and have no real eyelashes of my own left, so I was pleasantly surprised to find these so easy to use. I am used to using eyeliner, so all I had to do was place them on.  Easy-Peasy! Also, I love the 10 different styles to choose from.  I especially like the smaller, shorter style, since I am over 60 and don't want to look like a teenager.  They look very natural and last all day!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy and quick to apply, especially compared to glue-on lashes.
Many reviewers praise the strong hold, noting the lashes stay in place all day.
Several reviewers consider the product a great value for the price, with multiple lashes and liner included.
Some reviewers mention a learning curve or needing time to figure out placement.
A few reviewers criticize the eyeliner applicator or liner performance, including one reporting burning.
